_readme: S637 SkyPorpoise, 2026-11-11. De Anza's free capture on its 2026-2027 eLumen catalog (run 43024817869) found each program's page by its title and award (242 near misses, each 'the page's code tokens name 0 of N listed courses') and matched none of the course codes. The state's file lists ACCT 001A; the 2025-2026 PDF printed MATH D001A on its GE page. A finding to verify before any reader change: how do two program pages print their course codes? No model call.

questions.printed_codes: How does a 2026-2027 program page print a course code: ACCT 1A, ACCT 001A, ACCT D001A, or another form?

outside_hosts.elumenapp.com: De Anza College's own 2026-2027 catalog (deanza.elumenapp.com), served on its catalog vendor's domain, with the vendor's API its pages call (api-prod.elumenapp.com)
